# AI policy

We build Broccoli with AI coding tools, and you are welcome to use them too.

## The rules

- **A person answers for every change.** Whoever opens a pull request or an
  issue is its author, whatever tools helped. You must understand what you
  submit and be able to explain it.
- **Review before you submit.** Read and test AI-generated code as carefully
  as code you wrote yourself. Do not submit output you have not checked.
- **Keep it focused.** Large, unrelated or speculative changes produced by a
  tool will be closed.
- **No secrets or private data in prompts.** Never paste credentials, customer
  data or employee records into an AI tool.

## Issues and reports

Write issues and security reports yourself, or check every word of a generated
one. Reports that are clearly generated without checking will be closed.
